name: If I Could Love
source:
If I Could Love is a game about a college student who apparently cannot feel romantic love for mysterious reasons. It is later revealed that he is demiromantic. Although he isn't sure what type of aromanticism he has, he becomes depressed, feeling that he isn't normal.

This student's name is Takeru Miyamoto (sometimes called Teru by friends and family). He moves into Yokohama to enroll into Yorko High School. There, he meets four girls: Aoi Nakamura, Yui Hasegawa, Minami Nakagawa, and Shihiro Masamune. Each with their own distinct personalities. It's up to you, the player, to help Teru realize that his orientation isn't abnormal. Help him identify himself as a normal person.
